name: pboc_get_money_supply
description:
Chinese money supply (M0 currency in circulation, M1 or M2, national currency, monthly) from FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, IMF series).
Returns: series_code (FRED id), series_id, label, source, observation_count and observations (date, value) oldest first, missing values dropped.
Inputs (none required): aggregate (m0, m1, m2; default m2); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD); recent_periods (1-500; the last N observations; with no dates it looks back N x 45 days); omit all three for the full history.
For prices use pboc_get_inflation; all series: pboc_list_series. Needs a FRED API key (FRED_API_KEY, config fred.api.key); without one the call fails with a message saying so.
Example: {"aggregate": "m2", "start_date": "2020-01-01", "end_date": "2024-12-31"}
